mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plugin ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plugin (name, version, display_name, description, author, requires, jar_file, enabled, setting_name, config_map_name) VALUES (#{name}, #{version}, #{display_name}, #{description}, #{author}, #{requires}, #{jar_file}, #{enabled}, #{setting_name}, #{config_map_name})
mapper.update: UPDATE plugin SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE name = #{name}

UPDATE plugin SET version = #{version}, jar_file = #{jar_file}, display_name = #{display_name}, description = #{description}, author = #{author}, requires = #{requires}, setting_name = #{setting_name}, config_map_name = #{config_map_name} WHERE name = #{name}
